name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira's journey in motorsport began in his late teens, tinkering with go-karts in his hometown near Braga. He quickly developed a knack for understanding the intricate mechanics behind racing machines. After completing his engineering degree, he joined a local racing team, honing his skills as a data analyst and eventually transitioning into a race engineer role.

Ricardo's approach is meticulous and data-driven. He believes in a collaborative environment, though he often prefers to work independently, diving deep into the technical details. He is known for his ability to quickly identify and resolve mechanical issues, often finding innovative solutions under pressure. While he isn't one for the spotlight, his ambition is evident in his relentless pursuit of performance gains, constantly seeking that extra tenth of a second.

physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build, with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of espresso before every race.
